The '''Zed'hoffa Orbital Diving Competition''' was an extreme sport competition hosted over the [[Living Pits]] on [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] to attract more [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that could not [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]].
